# GameController

<!-- generated:header (isim/tools/coverage-summary.py; do not edit by hand) -->
**Symbols:** 31.5% of Apple's iOS API (288 of 914, exact) · **Rows:** 10: 4 ✅ 1 🟡 5 ❌ · **iOS:** 7.0+
<!-- /generated:header -->

**Area:** [Games & 3D](../COVERAGE.md#games) · **Apple:** [GameController](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/gamecontroller) · **Issues:** [`area:games`](https://github.com/kolabs-dev/isim/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Aarea%3Agames)

## How isim implements it

- **Passthrough:** host gamepads through SDL3 (`isim/runtime/host_gamepad.c`).
- **Adapted:** `GCVirtualController` is drawn by isim; the keyboard comes from the host.

## API

| API / feature | Status | iOS | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GCController` (`controllers()`, `current`, connect / disconnect / current notifications, `playerIndex`) | ✅ | ≤17 | virtual controller and host gamepads |
| `GCExtendedGamepad`, `GCMicroGamepad` (buttons, d-pad, thumbsticks, triggers, value / pressed / touched handlers) | ✅ | ≤17 | tested with the virtual controller |
| Physical game controllers on the host | ✅ | ≤17 | SDL3 gamepads (Xbox / PlayStation / Switch / generic via SDL's mapping database) polled at 60 Hz: each becomes a `GCController` with `GCExtendedGamepad` (+ micro profile), `vendorName` from SDL, `productCategory` from the SDL pad type; `ISIM_GAMEPADS=0` disables. Tested through an SDL virtual joystick (`gamepad` script command), not a physical pad |
| Gamepad rumble: `GCController.haptics`, `GCDeviceHaptics` (`supportedLocalities`, `createEngine(withLocality:)`), `GCHapticsLocality`, `GCHapticDurationInfinite` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: a host pad's haptics make CoreHaptics engines whose haptic events drive its two rumble motors through SDL (intensity split over the low- and high-frequency motors by sharpness); the handles only: trigger localities give no engine; snapshots and the virtual controller have none; tested (HelloSpriteKit2, test_spritekit2: the virtual test pad logs the rumble) |
| `GCKeyboard.coalesced`, `GCKeyboardInput` (`button(forKeyCode:)`, `keyChangedHandler`, `isAnyKeyPressed`), `GCKeyCode` | ✅ | ≤17 | the host keyboard; key presses and releases arrive as USB HID usages (scripts: `keydown`/`keyup`) |
| `GCVirtualController` (iOS 15) | 🟡 | ≤17 | thumbsticks, d-pad, A/B/X/Y, shoulders, triggers and menu drawn over the key window; element configurations only hide elements (custom paths ignored) |
| `GCMouse`, motion, light, battery | ❌ | ≤17 | no mice; the others are typed `AnyObject?` and nil: `GCDeviceBattery`, `GCDeviceLight`, `GCMotion` and `GCMouseInput` do not exist, so code using them does not compile |
| Types not yet in isim (iOS 17 and earlier) | ❌ | ≤17 | not implemented, found by the 2026-10 sweep: `GCAxisElement`, `GCAxisElementName`, `GCAxisInput`, `GCButtonElement`, `GCButtonElementName`, `GCDevicePhysicalInput`, `GCDevicePhysicalInputState`, `GCDevicePhysicalInputStateDiff`, `GCDirectionPadElement`, `GCDirectionPadElementName`, `GCEventViewController`, `GCLinearInput`, `GCPhysicalInputElement`, `GCPhysicalInputElementCollection`, `GCPhysicalInputElementName`, `GCPhysicalInputElementTypedName`, `GCPhysicalInputSource`, `GCPressedStateInput`, `GCRelativeInput`, `GCSwitchElement`, `GCSwitchElementName`, `GCSwitchPositionInput`, `GCTouchedStateInput` (23 types; with their members under "Not yet in isim") |
| Types not yet in isim (iOS 26) | ❌ | 26.2 | not implemented, found by the 2026-10 sweep: `GCPhysicalInputExtents` (1 type; with its members under "Not yet in isim") |
| Types not yet in isim (iOS 27) | ❌ | 27.0 | not implemented, found by the 2026-10 sweep: `GCControllerHomeButtonSettingCustomizationStatus`, `GCControllerHomeButtonSettingInAppAction`, `GCControllerHomeButtonSettingsCustomizationActivity`, `GCControllerHomeButtonSettingsManager`, `GCControllerHomeButtonSettingSystemAction` (5 types; with their members under "Not yet in isim") |
